notes.title: Platformer 0.2.1.0 Pre-Release Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828851/418cc4b19b0397a131902fd017585553da01b6e6.png[/img]

[h1]Platformer 0.2.1.0 Pre-Release Notes[/h1]
A warning in advance that the next update will wipe your character and world data.

Make sure to screenshot alpha maps and characters you want to remember, all pre-existing data will be lost in the 0.2.1.0 update.

While final changes are being made to the game structure, it's normal for data resets to occur. This should occur less often as development progresses.

For now, here is a sneak peak while we wrap things up

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828851/fe0acbbc20faf9f0f189b88538f3751e79df9f85.png[/img]

notes.title: V0.1.34 Trinkets, Achievements and Boss Monsters Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828851/418cc4b19b0397a131902fd017585553da01b6e6.png[/img]

[h1]V0.1.34 Trinkets, Achievements and Boss Monsters Update[/h1]
We are releasing a handful of new content and bugfixes!

[h3]Achievements were added![/h3]
You can now start earning achievements, more will be added over time.

[h3]You can now vertically scale walls with ladders![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828851/48b55b6d1b846eb3dd09718141406e099422ec45.png[/img]

[h2]What was fixed and added to the game?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new intro BGM
[*] Added new biome BGMs
[*] Added various trinkets
[*] Added boss events
[*] Added achievements
[*] Added more weapons
[*] Added new crafting recipes
[*] Added the bucket
[*] Added more decorative furniture
[*] Added snow biome
[*] Added pine trees
[*] Added statues
[*] Added ladders
[*] Added a handful of new monsters
[*] Improved server join speed
[*] Flowers and berries now grow in grass
[*] Upgraded light system
[*] Torches now emit more light
[*] Added more caves
[*] Optimized world deletion
[*] Adjusted parallax background effect
[*] Fixed many major and minor bugs
[*] Shift click will now auto-deposit items
[*] Stack splitting is now supported with right click
[*] Improved enemy AI
[/list]

[h2]Expected Gameplay Issues:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Using Hamachi may work better in multi-player for some users
[*] Background tiles occasionally leave left over pixels, reloading the map will temporarily fix it
[*] There are a few bugs in multi-player so don't be surprised if small problems occur
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828851/733f7218fb0cb7bc7c85c9c89fbd9db32fe108b2.png[/img]

[h3]Feeling like there is a limited amount of content?[/h3]
You're right! it's early access!

More content is coming soon, follow us on Steam for future updates.

notes.title: Platformer Early Access Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828851/418cc4b19b0397a131902fd017585553da01b6e6.png[/img]
[h1]Platformer early access is finally here![/h1]

Play single player by yourself or play multiplayer with 8 or less other players.

[h2]We are still in early access, what does this mean?[/h2]
It means more content will appear in the future!

[h2]What kind of content will appear in the future?[/h2]
[list]
[*] More biomes
[*] More enemies
[*] More weapons and armor
[*] New types of ore
[*] Boss fights
[*] Trinkets that give you exclusive skills
[*] Costumes for players to wear
[*] The core ( top secret! )
[*] Hard mode ( top secret! )
[*] And much more!
[/list]

Feeling like there is a limited amount of content?
You're right! it's early access!

More content is coming soon, follow us on Steam for updates.
